description: Hand-labelled attribution gold for mushoku16. Sampled uniformly from spoken, non-deterministic, textually unique segments; labelled without seeing any model output, so it can be used to measure model accuracy.

entries.line: In the future when things get tough, I might not depend on you, or do or say bad things.
entries.reasoning: spoken by Rudeus to Sylphy after she comforts him

entries.line: Umm... If that happens, I might get a little irritated at you, treat you coldly, and fight with you... But we can make up, right?
entries.reasoning: Sylphy responds to Rudeus asking her not to leave him

entries.line: Yeah. Of course we can. Mn, we can make up...
entries.reasoning: Rudeus reassures Sylphy that they can make up

entries.line: Well I don't lose anything, so it's fine but... Wah-
entries.reasoning: Sylphy gives permission before being picked up by Rudeus

entries.line: Don't we always talk...? Or is there something in particular that you'd like to talk about?
entries.reasoning: Roxy answers Rudeus when he asks to talk

entries.line: Hahh... Well, it's fine with me, but doing 'that' today is no good, you know?
entries.reasoning: Roxy sets boundaries regarding Rudeus wanting to be flirty

entries.line: No, no. Nothing at all. I was just thinking 'I'm really so happy that Roxy is alive' again.
entries.reasoning: Rudeus explains to Roxy why he is acting affectionate

entries.line: Roxy. Lately, have there been any weird changes to your body?
entries.reasoning: dialogue tag directly attributes the question to Rudeus

entries.line: Ehh? I'm fine, you know. Why did you ask something like that?
entries.reasoning: Roxy responds to Rudeus asking about bodily changes

entries.line: If you think about the lifespans of races, I'll live longer than you after all. I should be the one asking you to live longer, Rudi.
entries.reasoning: Roxy points out racial lifespan differences to Rudeus

entries.line: Sylphy has noticed too... Rudi when troubled rarely likes to talk about it... Let's just try to help him when the time comes.
entries.reasoning: dialogue tag attributes statement to Roxy speaking to Sylphy

entries.line: Ah, Roxy-san, Sylphy-san, can you come to my room after dinner?
entries.reasoning: dialogue tag explicitly attributes request to Rudi

entries.line: Recently, em... Luci, how is she?
entries.reasoning: Rudeus asks Sylphy about their daughter Luci

entries.line: That's actually what I asked you to come for today. That was it.
entries.reasoning: Rudeus addresses Sylphy and Roxy regarding why he gathered them

entries.line: Em.. Next, I don't know how I say this but... a few days ago, I met someone.
entries.reasoning: Rudeus continues explaining his encounter

entries.line: Yes, a miko that can predict the future... someone like that.
entries.reasoning: Rudeus answers Sylphy's clarification question

entries.line: Roxy won't mind?
entries.reasoning: Sylphy asks Roxy if she minds staying home

entries.line: ... You're right. Em, I understand.
entries.reasoning: Sylphy agrees with Roxy's perspective

entries.line: Then, when I have it bad, please come to my aid.
entries.reasoning: Rudeus responds to Roxy and Sylphy offering protection

entries.line: Who? Nanahoshi?
entries.reasoning: Sylphy asks if the new person mentioned is Nanahoshi

entries.line: She's not Nanahoshi.
entries.reasoning: Rudeus clarifies that the person isn't Nanahoshi

entries.line: I remember her. Rudi was her home tutor at Fortress City Roa back then, right?
entries.reasoning: dialogue tag states Roxy remembers who Eris is

entries.line: No, leaving is my misunderstanding. Lingering feelings and such, I don't think her heart has changed.
entries.reasoning: Rudeus explains that Eris leaving was due to a misunderstanding

entries.line: If Sylphy objects to marrying her, then let's just stop here. But ultimately I still want to clear the air with her.
entries.reasoning: Rudeus states his intentions to Sylphy regarding Eris

entries.line: Forgetting Roxy is impossible.
entries.reasoning: Rudeus reassures Roxy

entries.line: Yes, it's all your fault. Not thinking about what you're doing is your fault.
entries.reasoning: Hitogami blames Rudeus during their dream encounter

entries.line: I thought so too... until you showed up!
entries.reasoning: Hitogami explains why Orsted became a threat after Rudeus appeared

entries.line: Useless. That alone won't change fate.
entries.reasoning: Hitogami dismisses Rudeus's idea of family mottoes

entries.line: No, I'm not even sure if it's possible. But it might... You say you would do anything right?
entries.reasoning: Hitogami sets up his demand to kill Orsted

entries.line: Cough... Cough...
entries.reasoning: Roxy coughs after Rudeus releases his tight embrace

entries.line: Nanahoshi, I've brought some get well presents.
entries.reasoning: Rudeus offers get-well presents to Nanahoshi

entries.line: First I need you to listen, it might sound unbelievable at first though.
entries.reasoning: Rudeus asks Nanahoshi to listen before revealing his story

entries.line: The diary was written in Japanese, and my true name from my previous life.
entries.reasoning: Rudeus provides proof regarding his future self

entries.line: Then you are saying he fabricated the diary, and our entire conversation in my dream was nothing more than an act?
entries.reasoning: Rudeus questions Nanahoshi's skepticism

entries.line: I won’t say that but… is the Human God trustworthy?
entries.reasoning: Nanahoshi questions whether Hitogami is trustworthy

entries.line: But… there’s nothing I can do about it…
entries.reasoning: Rudeus expresses his sense of helplessness

entries.line: To be honest, about the Human God, I also heard about him from Orsted by chance.
entries.reasoning: dialogue tag introduces Nanahoshi's statement about Orsted

entries.line: mmmm… about that… He didn’t tell me you died but, perhaps because you know about Orsted’s location, and then, you would be more knowledgeable about this type of thing than me, and would probably be able to think up a plan.
entries.reasoning: Rudeus explains why his future self sent him to consult Nanahoshi

entries.line: I’m relying on you.
entries.reasoning: Rudeus takes his leave of Nanahoshi

entries.line: Where are you going this late at night?
entries.reasoning: Arumanfi calls out to Rudeus in the hallway

entries.line: To Nanahoshi’s room. Has she already gone to sleep?
entries.reasoning: Rudeus answers Arumanfi

entries.line: She just asked me for some pen and paper. She’s still awake.
entries.reasoning: Arumanfi informs Rudeus about Nanahoshi's status

entries.line: It’s Rudeus.
entries.reasoning: Rudeus identifies himself at Nanahoshi's door

entries.line: What’s the possibility of them dying as soon as they were transferred here?
entries.reasoning: Rudeus suggests a possibility about Nanahoshi's missing friends

entries.line: If the time he traveled was a hundred years, would it just end with his internal organs?
entries.reasoning: Nanahoshi poses analytical questions regarding time displacement

entries.line: You, after that incident, did you feel nothing wrong with your body? Like your magical power suddenly being drained very low for example?
entries.reasoning: Nanahoshi asks Rudeus about his physical condition post-disaster

entries.line: …. Is that your guess?
entries.reasoning: Rudeus asks if Nanahoshi's theory is a guess

entries.line: That’s a clue, right? Do you still remember when it first appeared?
entries.reasoning: Nanahoshi asks when the red sphere first appeared

entries.line: Originally, you’re not someone who should have existed in this world, right?
entries.reasoning: Nanahoshi notes that Rudeus is an foreign existence in this world

entries.line: What do you think is the reason you transferred to this world?
entries.reasoning: Nanahoshi asks Rudeus about his transfer reason

entries.line: I don’t understand. In the end, what are you trying to tell me?
entries.reasoning: Rudeus asks Nanahoshi for clarification

entries.line: I’m saying that in order for the world where the Human God dies in the future to exist, the two of us are necessary.
entries.reasoning: Nanahoshi answers Rudeus's request for clarification

entries.line: I understand your hypothesis.
entries.reasoning: Rudeus acknowledges Nanahoshi's hypothesis

entries.line: Please stop. The Human God is probably watching our movements at this very moment.
entries.reasoning: Rudeus warns Nanahoshi that Hitogami is watching

entries.line: …But, the Human God shouldn’t be able to just lay his hands on whoever he wants, right?
entries.reasoning: Nanahoshi questions the reach of Hitogami's power

entries.line: Orsted is the Dragon God. If the diary can be believed, then he probably knows a technique to go to the void world. If I kill him, if the method to travel to the void world disappears, then in reality, the Human God should lose his reason to target my children.
entries.reasoning: Rudeus explains his strategy for targeting Orsted

entries.line: ….. Yes. That’s right.
entries.reasoning: Nanahoshi hesitantly confirms she can contact Orsted

entries.line: Why are you looking at me with such pitiful eyes. Even I have already with Jino... No, never mind that.
entries.reasoning: Nina reacts defensively to Eris's pitiful look

entries.line: Come to think of it, I have heard a few rumors about your boyfriend.
entries.reasoning: Nina brings up rumors about Rudeus to Eris

entries.line: Somehow, it kind of feels like he's so strong that he's allowed to do whatever he likes?
entries.reasoning: Nina continues commenting on Rudeus's reputation

entries.line: Hey, Eris, just saying this as example, but could it be that...
entries.reasoning: dialogue tag confirms Nina asks Eris if she was forgotten

entries.line: I've made you wait.
entries.reasoning: dialogue tag attributes this arrival greeting to Ghyslaine

entries.line: No, a swordsman should fight fair and square from the front.
entries.reasoning: Nina rejects challenging the drunk Sword God dishonorably

entries.line: Such an honest and good child. Well, in the not so distant future, you should be able to win. Give it your best.
entries.reasoning: Water Style God Reida praises Nina's sportsmanship

entries.line: Eris, it's about time we head off.
entries.reasoning: Isolte calls to Eris that it is time to depart

entries.line: Hello. Mailman here, could someone please sign here?
entries.reasoning: unnamed mailman asking for a signature

entries.line: Just a minute, please sign. If I don't have that, I can't get the compensation.
entries.reasoning: unnamed mailman requesting Eris's signature

entries.line: What! If you can't read words when you need to, then you'll be in trouble!
entries.reasoning: Eris hypocritically lectures Nina about literacy

entries.line: Currently, I have two wives.
entries.reasoning: text from Rudeus's letter read aloud by Isolte

entries.line: I have made arrangements to accept you.
entries.reasoning: text from Rudeus's letter read aloud by Isolte

entries.line: In the case that you feel unhappy about this, I have already resolved to receive your fist.
entries.reasoning: text from Rudeus's letter read aloud by Isolte

entries.line: I feel even if you do not wish to become a member of my family, we could form a fine friendship.
entries.reasoning: text from Rudeus's letter read aloud by Isolte

entries.line: Is that right? I think he put a considerable amount of thought into writing it.
entries.reasoning: dialogue tag confirms Nina responding to Isolte in defense of Rudeus

entries.line: Wow, it has progressed better than I expected.
entries.reasoning: Hitogami greets Rudeus in his dream state

entries.line: Even I can't tell the outcome, how exciting!
entries.reasoning: Hitogami expresses excitement to Rudeus about the upcoming fight

entries.line: OF course, I'm Hitogami! Since I know about Fighting God's armor, I can give you some pointers.
entries.reasoning: Hitogami identifies himself while giving advice on magic armor

entries.line: Since you have been a harder worker than I expect, I ought to offer a hand as well. My desire to see Orsted dead is true.
entries.reasoning: Hitogami explains why he is helping Rudeus against Orsted

entries.line: Yep, just as you said. But if Roxy and you don't leave a child, I won't have to lie in the first place.
entries.reasoning: Hitogami addresses his past lies to Rudeus

entries.line: Don't worry.
entries.reasoning: Rudeus reassures Roxy

entries.line: Sorry... but would you please reconsider? About killing Orsted...
entries.reasoning: Nanahoshi begs Rudeus to reconsider fighting Orsted

entries.line: Ah, sorry, I understand.
entries.reasoning: Nanahoshi backs off upon realizing Rudeus won't change his mind

entries.line: Thought of anything?
entries.reasoning: Rudeus asks Nanahoshi if she came up with an idea

entries.line: Welcome, Rudeus-san, nice to meet you.
entries.reasoning: unnamed underground poison dealer greets Rudeus

entries.line: My wife is playful in bed.
entries.reasoning: Rudeus replies dryly to the drug dealer's comment

entries.line: Alright, I'll suit up. Sylphy, Zanoba, and Elinalise, you three come at once. Cliff, please activate your Identification Eye. If you notice something, I'm counting on you.
entries.reasoning: Rudeus instructs his allies for magic armor testing

entries.line: Whose... Unless, don't tell me, Rudeus?
entries.reasoning: Cliff nervously asks Elinalise whose baby she is carrying

entries.line: Alright alright.
entries.reasoning: Elinalise complies with Cliff's examination

entries.line: W-What? What do we do?
entries.reasoning: Cliff panics upon discovering Elinalise's pregnancy

entries.line: Don't do anything.
entries.reasoning: Elinalise tells Cliff to calm down and do nothing

entries.line: Rudi is my husband now, and I also want Rudi's child, so I think saying
entries.reasoning: Roxy expresses her feelings about carrying Rudeus's child

entries.line: Isn't that a bit bossy?
entries.reasoning: Rudeus teases Roxy about her phrasing

entries.line: Nii-san, please don't flirt so much during dinner.
entries.reasoning: dialogue tag attributes line to Norn addressing Rudeus

entries.line: Once in a while is fine. For Roxy-ane it's service, today only.
entries.reasoning: dialogue tag attributes line to Aisha defending Roxy and Rudeus

entries.line: Also... Aisha, didn't you say you have a good harvest of your rice crop recently? And how nii-san is going to be?
entries.reasoning: Norn brings up Aisha's rice crop to deflect attention

entries.line: No, that's fine. So next year, and next year too?
entries.reasoning: Rudeus excitedly asks Aisha about future rice harvests

entries.line: O-Onii-chan made soil with magic for me... Onii-chan's soil is the best!
entries.reasoning: Aisha praises Rudeus's magic soil

entries.line: O-oh... Hey, can I, jump?
entries.reasoning: Aisha asks Rudeus if she can jump into his arms

entries.line: Hey, Sylphy.
entries.reasoning: dialogue tag indicates Rudeus whispering to Sylphy under the table

entries.line: I hope you won't get angry for what I'm about to say.
entries.reasoning: Rudeus prepares Sylphy before making a proposition

entries.line: But, the baby in here... that's fine, okay.
entries.reasoning: Roxy accepts Rudeus into bed despite her pregnancy

entries.line: Anyways, please sit down.
entries.reasoning: Rudeus asks Roxy to sit down for a serious talk

entries.line: No. I'm not leaving. I just thought it might be better if I open the door again.
entries.reasoning: Rudeus reassures Sylphy that he is not leaving her room

entries.line: ... Stop. Really, we're talking about serious stuff right now.
entries.reasoning: Sylphy tells Rudeus to stop groping her during serious talk

entries.line: ... Soon, she will start talking, and in a year, she'll start to walk.
entries.reasoning: Sylphy speaks affectionately about Luci's development

entries.line: Fuguuuuaaa!
entries.reasoning: exclamation made by Rudeus while biting Orsted's leg

entries.line: Looks like I kept you waiting, Rudeus.
entries.reasoning: Eris greets Rudeus after arriving to save him

entries.line: We wanted to but he told us not to follow since we would just be a burden.
entries.reasoning: dialogue tag states Sylphy replied while crying

entries.line: Which do you want?
entries.reasoning: Sword God Gal Farion asks Eris which sword she wants to pick

entries.line: It didn’t fit me, but you can probably master it.
entries.reasoning: Sword God Gal Farion explains the properties of the sword

entries.line: Now then, to the main problem. First, your tactic against Orsted...
entries.reasoning: Sword God Gal Farion instructs Eris on tactics against Orsted

entries.line: ... That's surprising. Eris Boreas Greyrat will fight together with her companions. Is this also a part of your madness? Certainly, if Eris Boreas Greyrat held a little more judgement, if she were to study under a suitable master, I see... So this is what happens?
entries.reasoning: Orsted comments in surprise at Eris's tactical growth

entries.line: He won't be faster than you using his wrists, aim at it and chop it off
entries.reasoning: Sword God Gal Farion advises Eris in a flashback

entries.line: Sword God style hidden technique; 'Light Reversal'
entries.reasoning: Eris shouts her counter-technique name against Orsted

entries.line: That person, for some reason won't fight seriously.
entries.reasoning: Sword God Gal Farion analyzes Orsted's combat tendencies

entries.line: Seeing a technique for the first time, he will try to study it. That is probably his weak point.
entries.reasoning: Sword God Gal Farion points out Orsted's tendency to observe techniques

entries.line: Rudeus Greyrat!
entries.reasoning: dialogue tag confirms Orsted called out Rudeus's name

entries.line: That's just dumb!
entries.reasoning: Eris immediately rejects Orsted's proposal

entries.line: If you do, I'll forget about this ambush of yours, and I'll heal your injured arm!
entries.reasoning: Orsted offers terms of alliance to Rudeus

entries.line: Right now, even this conversation, will not reach him!
entries.reasoning: Orsted reassures Rudeus that Hitogami cannot hear them

entries.line: Choose! Rudeus Greyrat! Side with the Human God, and lose everything to me! or follow me, and fight the Human God together! If it's you, since it's you who is immune to my curse, then you should be able to choose with your own will!
entries.reasoning: Orsted gives Rudeus an ultimatum to join him

entries.line: Yeah, I had one too, so shouldn't she get one too?  I need to ask for a day off that day, so if you can tell me when...
entries.reasoning: Roxy explains why she asked about Eris's reception date

entries.line: Hey!  I'm being serious here.  Quit joking around!
entries.reasoning: Roxy scolds Rudeus for teasing her during a serious moment

entries.line: Excuse me, Eris.... sama?
entries.reasoning: Rudeus nervously addresses Eris after waking on her lap

entries.line: Eris... Em, I'm sorry.
entries.reasoning: Rudeus apologizes to Eris for past misunderstandings

entries.line: Rudeus-sama.
entries.reasoning: dialogue tag states Lilia spoke up quietly to address Rudeus

entries.line: Oh, what is it, Lilia?
entries.reasoning: Rudeus responds to Lilia addressing him

entries.line: Eris-sama, can I leave her in your care?
entries.reasoning: Ghyslaine asks Eris if she can entrust her responsibilities to her

entries.line: Yes, Eris-sama actually knows them better. What of it?
entries.reasoning: Ghyslaine confirms she knows the Water God and North Emperor

entries.line: Who is she?
entries.reasoning: Ghyslaine asks Rudeus who he is referring to

entries.line: Well, I was thinking, brother really was the teacher of Sword King-sama before.
entries.reasoning: Aisha shares her realization about Rudeus teaching Ghyslaine

entries.line: ... Oh, it's Eris.
entries.reasoning: Rudeus recognizes Eris holding him down in the dark

entries.line: I don't care about that. I don't even remember how to dance anymore... More importantly, as husband and wife, so it's okay right?
entries.reasoning: Eris focuses on being husband and wife immediately

entries.line: It's done. They will let me have today.
entries.reasoning: Eris informs Rudeus that Sylphy and Roxy gave her permission

entries.line: Roxy didn't say anything? Like hold back while she's pregnant or something?
entries.reasoning: Rudeus asks Eris if Roxy raised any concerns

entries.line: Rudeus, I like you, so, it's okay right?
entries.reasoning: Eris confesses her feelings directly to Rudeus

entries.line: Wow, amazing...
entries.reasoning: Rudeus marvels at Eris's abdominal muscle tone
